description: Diff one collection between two targets: added, removed, changed (with the fields that differ) and unchanged items, matched by key (auto-detected: name, channel, id, path, url, type+name … or pass key, a+b for composites). States completeness; unknown items are neither added nor removed. Each list pages on its own (list + offset). Without collection: counts per shared collection, to pick one.

ignore.description: Fields to exclude from change detection, in addition to the position rule

key.description: Item field used as identity (default: name, then JSON)

limit.description: Items per list in this answer (default 50 added/removed, 25 changed)

list.description: Page only this list; offset applies to it (each list has its own next)

strict.description: Count every difference. Default false: address fields of native symbols/sections that only moved are reported as relocated, with samples

name: hexvero_compare
title: Compare collections
